title:
Base type for data that needs to be cached per app. Sub-type can be any type whose instances will be cached.
Following sub-types are supported implicitly
 * Singleton (#inst)
 * DefaultInstance (#inst)
 * Config (#forConfigKey)

Persistable types can also mix Cached. In that case instances will be cached by their id. But needs to be explicitly

e.g.:
```
 entity type MyCachedData mixes Cached {
   data: any
 }
```
Then create / update and delete instance of MyCachedData as usual and use #forId or #find to get cached version(s).
Cache will be automatically refreshed when data gets modified in the database. However there will be a delay between
modify & delete and cache refresh.

Any other sub type of Cached will have to explicitly claim and implement #produce and #produceAll:
 If the sub type mixes:
  * Persistable (#forId) - #produce(key) should return instance by id=key and #produceAll should return all instances
  * Identified (#forId) - #produce(key) should return instance by id=key and #produceAll should return all instances
  * Named (#forName) - #produce(key) should return instance by name=key and #produceAll should return all instances
